guardrail_production_untouched.notes: 2026-10-20: A2 is live, so the old 'every flag OFF, zero kit references' invariant was replaced, not dropped. Now: exactly one flag on (deploy_gate_flag); only the four A2-wired files may reach the kit; no module-level kit import in production; flag off means no receipt attached; the gate runs before wrangler.
